why: 4.0 ships without the debugger permission. These scenarios exercise what only the debugger can do (real key and pointer input, listener discovery), so they cannot pass in the shipped build. They still run in the nightly debugger-on suite. Measured on 10 Nov 2026: results/e2e/e2e-debugger-off-2026-11-10.txt, 52 of 59 pass, 7 fail. slowResults was the seventh: it passes in the shipped build now that the wait counts the page's own requests, so it is no longer listed.
